summary: Replace placeholder monitoring with checked process metrics and diagnostic runbooks
details: Provide separate authenticated API and worker scrape examples, actionable alert rules and an import-bound Grafana dashboard using emitted metrics.
Validate exporter metadata, PromQL, bounded labels, aggregation and runbook sections through make observability-check.
Document threshold calibration, counter resets, repeated shared queue gauges, retention and concrete dependency diagnosis.
Select PostgreSQL 16 native recovery clients in production CI to match the fixture and preserve paired-backup rehearsal compatibility.

compatibility.notes: Runtime metric names and scrape authorization are unchanged. Example alerts and dashboard queries replace the prior tenant-only placeholders; operators must review routing, topology and credential-file mounts. Offline validation requires Node 22 and make observability-tools for the pinned official Prometheus editor grammar/type linter; the Go server-module dependency has been removed.

security: Use distinct credential-file references without reading secrets; preserve instance authority, bounded labels and restricted operator diagnostics.
limitations: Offline example validation does not prove deployed collection, Grafana import, notification delivery or capacity.
Thresholds require operator calibration and do not establish SLOs, evidence verification or compliance.
